concerns.observation: Three processed physical runRealtimeReport sites contain only deliver/receive operations to task-local getActiveUsers/getRealtimeEvents/getRealtimePages tools. Their locations have task access and task retention. They have no network_send sink or concrete remote request at these coordinates.
concerns.impact: These processed IR cannot be counted as faithfully modeled remote exposure sites; the standalone source contains real Google client calls.

concerns.observation: All 21 processed saveResult call sites contain a delivery to the save location, declared kind=tool, access_scope=task and retention=task. No storage_write sink appears at any of these callers. Four additional save sites are blocked. The separate public saveResult utility has directory creation at ir_442 and file write at ir_454.
concerns.impact: A standalone public storage write does not instantiate persistence for each caller's report/aggregate/member version. Therefore 21 processed saves are not 21 source-supported persisted-result boundaries.

concerns.observation: The ordinary indexing-batch member call ir_331 is only a task-local toolkit requestIndexing tool. The normal submitted/inspected cases at ir_416/ir_428 also use local toolkit tools. Their explicit network_send records occur only in after_publish_entry/after_inspect_entry post_request_error cases (event 8/event 13).
concerns.impact: All ten loop structures process, but successful per-member network effects are not faithfully expanded. Separate standalone API functions do not establish these callers' member/request provenance.

concerns.observation: The unchanged CFG has no summary generation or Markdown writer IR. The selected processing gap at ir_511 explicitly states that source analysis entry points discard save paths and there is no binding from a particular analysis invocation to selected saved content, summary writer or user delivery.
concerns.impact: The narrative summarize stage is not established by the physical 13/25 site counts or by standalone file reads.

concerns.observation: The original destructuring reads filters and orderBy, and CFG metadata retains them as unused. Selected compiled processing only selects dimensions, metrics, dateRange and limit plus computes save; it contains no select_part for filters/orderBy and no explicit model-observation operation at this IR.
concerns.impact: A claim that unused input reads were preserved at field level is not supported for these two source fields. Their documentation/implementation mismatch remains distinct from a task-preserving deletion conclusion.

concerns.observation: The finalized manifest records unresolved_path for one predecessor path at wrapper construction ir_453 and missing_part diagnostics for content/value on literal candidates at ir_460/ir_462. All three IR nevertheless have overall processed status and operation records.
concerns.impact: Processed means the abstract solver produced a record, not that every predecessor/candidate path or source relationship is fully established.
